title: All Seven Emirates
body: Mobile teams based in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Sharjah, with scheduled routes covering Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah and Umm Al Quwain. Tell us the area and we confirm a realistic window rather than a slogan.

title: 24-Hour Emergency Line
body: Leaks and total loss of flow are answered around the clock and dispatched ahead of routine work, because both cause damage while they wait.

title: Technicians, Not Salespeople
body: The person at your door is a trained plumber and filtration technician who can diagnose and repair on the spot — which is also why the recommendation is sometimes that you need nothing.

title: Manufacturer-Supplied Parts
body: Cartridges, membranes and pumps sourced through authorised channels, matched to specification rather than to whatever happens to fit the housing.

title: Fixed Written Quotes
body: A price in AED, in writing, before work starts — with no call-out fee. What we quote is what you pay.

title: Measured, Not Guessed
body: Every recommendation starts from TDS and hardness measured at your own tap. We publish no water-quality figures for any emirate, because the only reading worth specifying against is yours.
